_comment: Soundboard script for tools/gen-audio.mjs. Original lines only, never the book's boxed text (the repo is public). Write lines the way people talk; [tags] are performed by eleven_v4. A clip's file is assets/audio/<id>.mp3; delete it to regenerate. A voice with no id is skipped until it has one. Bit-part stock voices differ from Double Exposure's (same players across the campaign).

playlists.name: Missions Soundboard — Under the Influence: Gone Dark

clips.label: Read-aloud: Captain Burns's office
clips.text: [dry] Captain Burns looks unhappy today. [pause] He always looks unhappy. But today, more so... and he's called you into his office, which means whatever he's about to say is going to make you unhappy too.

clips.label: Burns: sit down
clips.text: [gruff sigh] Sit. [beat] No, the other chair. That one's mine.

clips.label: Burns: one of ours went dark
clips.text: One of our undercover people has gone dark. Franco Tanner. [pause] He was inside a gang called the Futuremen, and his last report named somebody called... Doctor Cuca.

clips.label: Burns: quietly
clips.text: [low] The brass wants him found. Quietly. [beat] No press, no task force, no cowboy drek. You bring him home, and nobody ever hears about it.

clips.label: Read-aloud: the Solomon Arms
clips.text: [wry] The Solomon Arms has seen better decades. [pause] Third floor, Tanner's suite: locked, quiet, no sign of a struggle. Just a slob's nest of dirty socks and Nuke-It Burger wrappers... and garbage that hasn't started to stink yet. [low] He's been gone maybe a day.

clips.label: SFX: run-down hotel corridor
clips.sfx: A run-down hotel hallway at night: a buzzing broken light, a distant trideo through a thin wall, a creaking floorboard

playlists.name: Missions Soundboard — Under the Influence: Chez Cuca

clips.label: SFX: MindSound Music (loop)
clips.sfx: A small music store: soft synth music playing on speakers, a door chime, faint chatter and an espresso machine from a cafe next door

clips.label: Read-aloud: MindSound Music
clips.text: [low] MindSound Music is legit enough on the surface. [pause] A cheap electronics shop, an Amazonian café... and somewhere under all of it, a body shop, screened behind layers of misdirection and one very friendly clerk.

clips.label: Lindy: can I help you?
clips.text: [easygoing] Hey, welcome in! Looking for anything special today? [beat] Or... something not on the shelves?

clips.label: Lindy: who sent you?
clips.text: [friendly, but watching] Sure, I might know a guy. [pause] Who sent you down here, though? I like to know who I'm talking to.

clips.label: Lindy: the doctor will see you
clips.text: [pleased] All right, you check out. [lowering voice] Follow me downstairs. The doctor'll take good care of you.

clips.label: Lindy: just a minute
clips.text: [too casual] Oh, the doctor? Yeah, yeah, he's just finishing up with someone. [beat] Grab a seat. Shouldn't be more than a minute.

clips.label: Lindy: never heard of him
clips.text: [blank smile] Cuca? Tanner? [shrugs] Never heard of either one, officer. Can I interest you in a synth?

clips.label: Cuca: welcome, my friends
clips.text: [delighted] Ah! Come in, come in! [laughs] Sit, please, sit. You want speed? Strength? I have things here the corporations won't sell you for another ten years!

clips.label: Cuca: you don't need it, you want it
clips.text: [eagerly] You don't need it, my friend — you want it. That's different! [leaning in] And for you? A very special price.

clips.label: Cuca: trust me
clips.text: [warm, a little manic] Relax. Breathe. [softly] Trust me — you'll never feel better in your life.

playlists.name: Missions Soundboard — Under the Influence: Whose Side Are You On?

clips.label: Read-aloud: the warehouse
clips.text: [tense] An abandoned warehouse near Green Lake. Even the rats have left. [pause] Footsteps — far end of the alley. Then behind you. Then everywhere. [beat] Tanner's clawing for his Browning... and he's pointing it at you.

clips.label: SFX: footsteps closing in
clips.sfx: Many heavy boots splashing through puddles in a dark alley, closing in from several directions, a gun being cocked

clips.label: Tanner: I'm fine
clips.text: [distant, flat] I'm fine. [pause] I'm fine. Let's just... get to the meet.

clips.label: Tanner: I can't stop
clips.text: [strained, fighting himself] Get down — I can't — [gasps] I can't stop my hands! Get away from me!

clips.label: Tanner: it's me again
clips.text: [weak, shaking] It's me. It's... me again. [breathing hard] He put something in my head. Cuca. [quietly] Get it out.

clips.label: Futureman: ambush
clips.text: [shouting] Now! Light 'em up! [laughs] Doc says nobody walks away!

clips.label: Futureman: is that all?
clips.text: [grunts, then laughs] Is that all you got? [cracking knuckles] My turn.

clips.label: Read-aloud: time to pay
clips.text: [grim] Enough is enough. A private army in the streets is bad. Bagging a fellow officer? [pause] That's the thing the Star does not tolerate. [beat] As you check your sidearm, you secretly hope the doctor resists arrest.

clips.label: Powell: wipe it
clips.text: [cold, clipped, into a commlink] Start the wipe. All of it. [pause] And arm the charges — I want nothing left down here.

clips.label: Powell: let's be reasonable
clips.text: [smooth] Let's be reasonable. You don't want Renraku as an enemy. [beat] Walk away now, and there's a very generous bonus in it for everyone.

clips.label: Cuca: you don't understand
clips.text: [frantic] You don't understand what this is! [pleading] Ten years of work — ten years! You can't just throw it away!

clips.label: Cuca: not like this
clips.text: [panicked laugh] No. No, no, no — not like this. [breathless] Powell! Powell, wait for me!

clips.label: SFX: demolition countdown
clips.sfx: An automated electronic voice-less countdown: urgent beeping that speeds up, a facility alarm wailing underneath

playlists.name: Missions Soundboard — Malpractice: Joining the Wagon

clips.label: SFX: Pier 60 restaurant (loop)
clips.sfx: A busy waterfront restaurant: chatter, cutlery, a child laughing, seagulls and harbour boat horns outside the windows

clips.label: Read-aloud: Pier 60
clips.text: [light] A little boy caroms off your leg on his way to the window — [pause] boats! — before his mother drags him off, apologising. The suits all around pretend not to stare. [beat] And at a big booth loaded with food, in a faded Sonics shirt, sits your contact.

clips.label: Doctor Bob: hoi!
clips.text: [warmly] Hoi! Glad you came. Sit, sit! [laughs] No way I finish all this alone. I didn't know what you'd like, so I ordered two of everything.

clips.label: Doctor Bob: my team
clips.text: [quiet, heavy] I used to save lives for a living. [pause] Then a man named Brown came asking for client records. I said no. [beat] Three days later my team was dead. Everybody thinks I am too.

clips.label: Doctor Bob: the mole
clips.text: [earnest] Somebody inside DocWagon is still feeding him. Selling people's DNA. [firmly] I need you to find out who.

clips.label: Doctor Bob: I can't pay much
clips.text: [sheepish] I'll be honest, I can't pay much. [beat] But I can promise you this is the right thing to do. [small laugh] That's worth something, right?

clips.label: Read-aloud: Redmond clinic
clips.text: [measured] The Redmond clinic is too white, too clean, and smells of the sick and the dead. [pause] The Citymaster's parked exactly where Bob said... and a dwarf woman leans on its door, watching you come.

clips.label: Yamato: need a shot of Morphine?
clips.text: [dry] Any of you need a shot of Morphine?

clips.label: Yamato: get in
clips.text: [brisk] Get in. [beat] It's time to turn you lot into spies.

clips.label: Yamato: forty-eight hours
clips.text: You've got forty-eight hours to learn what took our medics two years. [flatly] Don't embarrass me, and don't blow my cover.

clips.label: Yamato: hard proof
clips.text: [serious] Get me hard proof one of the four is the mole. [pause] Until then my hands are tied. [beat] And he's no use to me dead. Understood?

clips.label: SFX: DocWagon garage klaxon
clips.sfx: A large ambulance garage: a loud alert klaxon, an ambulance siren starting up and screeching out, engines echoing

clips.label: Seth: welcome to Team Three
clips.text: [calm, businesslike] Seth Palatine. Team lead. [beat] You'll be riding Threat Response with us. Keep up and do what I say, and we'll get along fine.

clips.label: Viv: call me Viv
clips.text: [bright, warm] Call me Viv! [laughs] Oh, don't mind the trid, it's always on. Tea? You look like you could use a tea.

clips.label: Hawkeye: the new terps
clips.text: [not looking up] Oh great, the new terps. [snorts] Try not to bleed on my kimono, it's silk.

clips.label: Seth: that's Shawn
clips.text: [mildly] There's also Shawn. [pause] I think he might be sleeping.

clips.label: Dispatch: crisis call
clips.text: [over a PA, urgent] Expert Team Three, report to ambulance eight-four-four-oh-one! Crisis at Thomas and Fairview — immediately!

clips.label: SFX: Citymaster under siren
clips.sfx: An armoured ambulance racing through city streets under a wailing siren, engine roaring, tyres squealing round a corner

clips.label: Seth: here's the situation
clips.text: [crisp] Here's the situation, terps. Client's twenty-three, registered datajack. [pause] Severe head trauma — and there's gunfire on the call.

clips.label: Seth: get a move on
clips.text: [urgent] Come on, terp, get a move on! [shouting] The longer we wait, the sooner she dies!

clips.label: SFX: firefight at the scene
clips.sfx: Small and medium calibre gunfire cracking along a city street, rounds pinging off a vehicle, distant police sirens

clips.label: Viv: deep breath, love
clips.text: [gentle, steady] Deep breath, love. Look at me — not at the blood. [softly] That's it. We've got you.

clips.label: Hawkeye: wisecrack
clips.text: [grinning] Relax, I've done this a hundred times. [beat] Well, ninety. [laughs] Okay, twelve. But I was great in all twelve.

clips.label: Hawkeye: crashing
clips.text: [bitter, snapping] What? What are you looking at? [sneering] You think you're better than me, terp? Say it. Go on, say it.

clips.label: Gloria Tanaka: the call
clips.text: [breathless, panicked] My name is Gloria Tanaka — please, you have to hurry! [voice shaking] The cockatrices got out. Everyone's on the floor, they can't move, and they're starting to wake up!

clips.label: Gloria: don't hurt them
clips.text: [frantic] Don't hurt them! [quickly] Each one's worth two hundred thousand nuyen — Mr. Barnsworth will kill me!

clips.label: SFX: cockatrices in the warehouse
clips.sfx: Dozens of large agitated birds squawking and screeching in an echoing warehouse, wings flapping, a crate falling

clips.label: Yamato: someone tampered with the logs
clips.text: [flustered, fast] Glad I caught you. Someone tampered with the security logs — [breath] the DNA records were accessed three hours ago. I think the mole makes the drop tonight. Be on the lookout for—

clips.label: Yamato: keep your eyes open
clips.text: [over a klaxon] Dammit. [quickly] Keep your eyes open. Good luck!

clips.label: SFX: tyre blowout and crash
clips.sfx: A sharp tyre blowout pop, an ambulance swerving and grinding along concrete, then slamming into a metal street light

clips.label: Shawn: brace for impact
clips.text: [sudden, sharp] Brace for impact!

clips.label: Shawn: be right back
clips.text: [quietly] Front right tyre blew. Radio's down. [pause] There's a telecom booth just over there. [beat] Be right back.

clips.label: Read-aloud: the construction site
clips.text: [uneasy] An easy one, the call said. Just a hurt kid. [pause] The gates stand wide open; skeleton buildings pierce the night. A small crumpled form lies at the base of the nearest frame... [beat] and then a light blazes from the second floor.

clips.label: SFX: guided explosions
clips.sfx: Two large explosions hitting near a vehicle at night, a rising whine before each impact, metal groaning as the vehicle tips over

clips.label: Brown: target acquired
clips.text: [cold, flat] Target acquired. [pause] Range: three hundred meters. [beat] Correcting.

clips.label: Brown: everyone has a price
clips.text: [calm, menacing] Everyone has a price. [pause] The doctor's was going to be very generous. [beat] Yours is going to be very short.

clips.label: Brown: you again
clips.text: [almost amused] You again. [flatly] My files said you were dead, Doctor. [pause] I'll correct them.

clips.label: Shawn: you don't know
clips.text: [quiet, bitter] You don't know what it's like. [voice rising] They left me in the water. They left me to drown because I'm a dwarf!

clips.label: Shawn: nobody asked
clips.text: [barely audible] Nobody ever asked me. [pause] Nobody ever looks at me. [bitter laugh] Brown did.

clips.label: Yamato: that's him
clips.text: [tired, satisfied] That's him. [beat] Take him. Gently — he's no use to me dead. [to the team] Good work. Really.

clips.label: Doctor Bob: thank you
clips.text: [quiet, emotional] Thank you. [pause] I can't bring them back. [breath] But maybe now nobody else ends up like my team.
